setup: Expand along the first row: each entry times its two-by-two minor, with signs \(+, -, +\).

steps.say: Entry [[a]] with the minor from rows 2–3, columns 2–3: \([[m1]] = [[v1]]\).
Entry [[b]] with the minor from columns 1 and 3: \([[m2]] = [[v2]]\), taken with a minus sign.
Entry [[c]] with the minor from columns 1 and 2: \([[m3]] = [[v3]]\).
